# Owned inherited protected allocation fixture

A child in another package extends Parent<URI> and calls its inherited protected
instance String method inside a real URI construction. The member consumes no
class formal. Frozen ordinary and overriding receivers keep virtual dispatch,
input identity, callback effects, null receiver behavior and exact failures.
Four routes run 96 fresh JVM cases twice. Source and SDK-parent profiles compile
all output and preserve original entries, metadata and Exceptions. Six wrong
programs and six Code-preserving controls guard dispatch, behavior and scoped
inheritance. Only owned fixture and standard SDK code executes. Use JDK 25;
originals use release 8 and recovery uses its reported Java release.
